finding: Does timing still help after generic tempering and robust pooling? In D10, 43 of 120 nonstructural settings (35.8%) retain observed gains above 0.02 nats over a validation-tuned tempered reader. The variance-floored pooled gain is 0.00203 nats. All 253,952 retained cases, 248 intervals and full replay verify. This is a descriptive constructed-method result; N2's frozen stop remains unchanged.
